escalation.ask: The national payment network is down: all requests time out. Contact the network operator to restore service. Clearing will drain its 110-item backlog once the network answers. Do not quarantine item 95, because it is waiting on the network and is not malformed.

sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed: the national payment network, run by another organisation, is down, and every call fails or times out at about 2 seconds. Clearing cannot send payments, so its backlog of 110 items is growing.
sbar.background: The network stopped answering, with 100% of requests failing (baseline 0%) and p95 latency at 2023 ms (baseline 30 ms). The screening-standby restarts by the pipeline and the ops-maintenance on the same release were routine and caused no symptom.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is an external outage of the payment network (confidence 0.92), and the clearing log shows 'payment network timeout; item stays pending item_id=95'. Item 95 is waiting on the network and is not poison, and no allowed action could fix this, so the incident commander escalated it to the network operator itself.
sbar.recommendation: Follow up with the network operator to restore service, then confirm clearing drains its 110-item backlog once the network answers. Do not quarantine item 95. The operations team should review the delayed payments held in the clearing backlog.
